children: Asian currencies are consolidating versus the dollar, but may be weighed down by cautious sentiment. Markets have historically risen around the midterm elections, Commerzbank Research analysts say in a note. However, the combination of the artificial intelligence trade unwind and election uncertainty has kept risk appetite subdued, they add. The U.S. dollar is little changed at 157.87 yen, while the Australian dollar is 0.1% lower at US$0.6991, LSEG data show.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
